note: Geometry and paper presets. pageW/pageH and all margins are in points. "faces" is the card's natural count -- a double-sided sheet is two faces -- and is the anchor auto starts from, not a hard limit. "screen" marks a preset that is never printed, so it has no back to duplex and its faces need not come in pairs.

card-7x5-4col.name: 7×5in landscape · 4 columns
card-7x5-4col.note: Matches the reference sheet: 1.662in columns, 0.0507in gap.

phone-1col.name: Phone screen · 1 column
phone-1col.note: 2.5x5.5in, which is the physical size of a 6in phone screen -- so the type sizes and the per-script legibility floors, all in points, are what the reader actually sees. Whole pixels at every dpi the panel offers: 375x825, 750x1650, 1500x3300. One column, because two would be 79pt wide against the 115-138pt every other preset gives a column.

phone-19-5x9.name: iPhone 15/16 · Galaxy S24 · 2.17:1
phone-19-5x9.note: The commonest phone shape: 19.5:9, as on iPhone 12 through 16 and the Galaxy S line. Sized from a 6.1in diagonal, so a point here is a point on the glass and the per-script legibility floors mean what they say.

phone-20x9.name: Pixel · most Android · 2.22:1
phone-20x9.note: Google Pixel and much of Android: 20:9. Sized from a 6.2in diagonal, so a point here is a point on the glass and the per-script legibility floors mean what they say.

phone-19-3x9.name: Galaxy S Ultra · 2.14:1
phone-19-3x9.note: The large Samsung shape: 19.3:9. Sized from a 6.8in diagonal, so a point here is a point on the glass and the per-script legibility floors mean what they say.

phone-16x9.name: iPhone SE · older Android · 1.78:1
phone-16x9.note: 16:9, as on the iPhone SE and Android before the tall screens. Sized from a 4.7in diagonal, so a point here is a point on the glass and the per-script legibility floors mean what they say.

phone-18x9.name: Older Android · 2.00:1
phone-18x9.note: 18:9, the first generation of tall Android screens. Sized from a 5.8in diagonal, so a point here is a point on the glass and the per-script legibility floors mean what they say.

tablet-3x2.name: iPad · tablet · 1.44:1
tablet-3x2.note: A tablet in portrait, near 3:2. Wide enough for two columns. Sized from a 10.9in diagonal, so a point here is a point on the glass and the per-script legibility floors mean what they say.
